messages:
alex: Quick huddle: we need owners for all customer-facing follow-ups on the inference latency incident. Items: 72h customer note, public statuspage blurb, RCA redaction rules, verification plan, and recurrence tagging.
sara: I'll draft the 72h customer note. Aim to include brief impact, mitigation, and next steps. Due +48h.
ben: I'll own the public status blurb and confirm timestamps with infra. Due +24h.
omar: I'll coordinate RCA redaction rules with legal/privacy. Proposed checklist below.
legal: High level: no PII, no raw stack traces, mask IDs and IPs, avoid vendor names in public copy unless vendor approved; enterprise RCAs via support ticket + legal review (NDA when needed).
ops-bot: Postmortem page: https://redwood/pms/1879990001 (editable)
alex: Redaction checklist proposal:
- remove IPs/hostnames
- mask customer IDs (show rounded counts)
- no raw stack traces or auth tokens
- summarize third-party errors without naming endpoints
If a customer requests deeper logs, route via support + legal for controlled disclosure.
sara: Draft status snippet suggestion:
```
We experienced a brief increase in request latency affecting a subset of inference requests between 02:15-02:42 UTC. The issue has been mitigated and service is operating normally. We are investigating root cause and will share updates.
```
ben: Suggest using "brief" instead of "intermittent" and "increase in latency" instead of "throttling" for customer clarity.
alex: Action items I'll add to tracker now:
- ACTION-8210: Statuspage blurb (ben) - due +24h
- ACTION-8211: 72h customer note (sara) - due +48h
- ACTION-8212: RCA redaction checklist (omar) - due +36h
- ACTION-8213: Legal review (legal) - due within 24h of ACTION-8212
- ACTION-8214: Verification & 7d monitoring (SRE+infra) - due +7d
- ACTION-8215: Recurring-pattern memo (platform-eng) - due +3d
omar: Noting recurring-pattern: platform team flagged similar scaling regressions 4x in last 120 days. Tagging incident as "recurring-pattern" and pinging platform-eng. Internal memo only unless legal approves public mention.
ben: Ops will confirm exact timestamps and update status blurb before publish.
sara: I'll include a short FAQ in the 72h note about what customers can expect and how to request enterprise RCA review.
alex: Thanks everyone — I'll consolidate drafts into the postmortem doc and assign reviewers. Please update the tracker when you start your action. :thumbsup:
